Problem

Lab 4 requires a consistent Zen Green interface with reliable keyboard operation, responsive layouts and safe recovery across role dashboards, Actions Taken and earlier workflows. Query/hash context selected the wrong Staff screen or lost active navigation, long names pushed My Tickets controls outside the viewport, and blur validation could move Create Action before a pointer click finished. Communication validation and denied access also needed clearer feedback, while pending recovery/removal controls needed protection.

Changes
Resolve Staff/Admin screens and active navigation from the pathname while preserving query/hash context; make the Staff/Admin skip link explicitly focus main content.
Wrap shell navigation, identity, dashboard headings and My Tickets headings; allow dashboard count grids to shrink and separate count labels/values. Remove page clipping that concealed overflow, and wrap long table text/filenames.
Defer Action blur validation when focus moves to Submit so one pointer click validates the entire draft and focuses the first invalid field.
Give Public Comment/Internal Note fields required/invalid/help semantics, first-invalid-field focus and shared Zen Green styling. Keep drafts after recoverable failure; hide prior entries and posting controls after 401/403/404; reject malformed successful responses safely.
Lock repeated resolution indications and attachment removal; retain the modal/reason while removal is pending and allow Escape after recovery. Handle failed workflow reloads without unhandled rejection and disable recovery controls while pending.
Add a deterministic UI audit for all three roles at desktop/tablet/mobile/reflow sizes: complete axe checks, actual control bounds, clipping/overlap, 44px mobile targets, keyboard drill-down/skip links, Action validation/Escape, modal trapping/focus return and safe draft recovery. Keep fixture screenshots/JSON separate from real API/database evidence.
Extend component regression, CI, README and the verification runner. --issue=60 stores fresh logs/source provenance separately from historical Issue test(lab-04): verify complete lifecycle, migration, and Labs 1-3 regression #59 results. Update the completed visual/accessibility checklist and AI-use record.
Validation

Local verification on 2026-10-03, 19:47–20:00 Asia/Bangkok, on the uncommitted fix/lab4-ui-accessibility-hardening worktree based on 68ce6ea:

Check	Actual result
Server regression	39 files / 586 tests passed
Client regression	22 files / 170 tests passed
Required Lab 4 live E2E	14 passed: Actions Taken 7, Ticket resolution 3, dashboards 4
Labs 1–3 browser regression	18 passed: authentication/admin/queue/staff/communications 5, responsive 6, Requester/attachments/ownership/retry/accessibility 7
New visual/accessibility audit	13 passed, 63 screenshot/JSON pairs, zero WCAG-tagged axe violations in fixture captures
Dashboard performance	Passed: Requester p95 9.29 ms, IT Staff 21.32 ms, Administrator 16.13 ms; budget 500 ms
Server/client lint and build; Prisma validation	Passed
Diff and evidence-link checks	Passed

The full run passed 18/19 commands; the last Requester suite encountered Chromium net::ERR_NETWORK_CHANGED during a Public Comment POST and correctly retained the draft. A targeted rerun passed all seven Requester tests. Both run manifests have identical source SHA-256 maps and report unchanged source during execution. The combined final manifest explicitly retains the initial failure and same-source rerun; it does not claim the first run was entirely green.

Detailed verification, completed UI checklist, fixture screenshot/assertion catalog. Real API/database screenshots remain in the existing Lab 4 screenshot directories and were regenerated by the live suites. Initial diagnostic attempts are retained separately in artifacts/lab-04/issue-60-diagnostic/ and are not final passing evidence.

Hosted CI on the eventual PR head, peer approval, independent manual zoom/screen-reader checks and final-main/PDF release verification remain pending. These local results apply to the recorded worktree, not the baseline commit alone or final main.

Dependencies

Requires the Actions Taken API/UI, final Ticket workflow and Requester/Staff/Administrator dashboards already integrated into lab4-staging (PRs #65–#69). Branch flow: fix/lab4-ui-accessibility-hardening → lab4-staging → main.

Reference: SE+Lab+4.pdf, §7–8, §10, §12 and Answer Part 9. Description structure follows previous PRs #68–#69: Problem, Changes, Validation and Dependencies.
